name: College of Science Summer Camps (Explore Science camps)
what_you_do: These are week-long residential science camps. They have hands-on labs and experiments. For 2027, high school camps are Explore Science for rising 9th and 10th graders. Explore Life Science and Explore Physical Science are for rising 11th and 12th graders.
grades: Rising 9th to 12th (Explore Science 9-10; Life and Physical Science camps 11-12)
who_can_apply: Rising high school students in the grade band for each camp. No GPA or residency rule appears on the pages.
pay_detail: 2027 price $1,225 per camper. Camp fees cover instruction, supplies, room and board; need-based scholarships are available in the application.
duration: 5 days, Sunday to Thursday (2027: Jun 27 to Jul 1, Jul 11 to 15, Jul 18 to 22)
deadline_text: Registration opens in late January 2027. Offers go out weekly from late February. Applications close June 1, 2027, or when camps fill.
how_to_apply: Sign up on the College of Science camps page to hear when registration opens. Then apply online. Ask for a scholarship in the parent part of the form. Cancellation refund minus a $30 fee until 4 weeks before camp.
notes: Explore Science rising 9-10 camp was listed as full in 2026. Questions: explorescicamp@vt.edu. Not a job, so no work permit.
